{{Quote|I was just thinking that some of the smugglers who hang out here must have gone head-to-head with either the ''Sarissa'' or the Golan over the years. Maybe we should bring Han back and see if he can sound out the locals for us.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Choices" />}}
The '''''Sarissa''''' was a [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnought]] that served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by guarding the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector's]] [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]] as part of the [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] [[Ferrouz's sector fleet|fleet]]. Imperial [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] sent the dreadnought's [[Caldorf VII interceptor missile]]s to Poln's [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Poln Minor]], where [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s [[Thief/Legends|stole]] them and loaded them aboard Esva's fifty [[Whisperlike fighter]]s in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. The dreadnought later [[Battle of the Poln system|fought]] Esva's [[Eastern Fleet]] along with other Imperial forces.

==Description==
{{Quote|Are you aware that all fifty of the ''Sarissa''{{'s}} Caldorf VII interceptor missiles were removed four days ago?''"<br />"''Yes, of course. The notice came through last week&mdash;some possible malfunction in the guidance systems, I'm told. They're at the Spillwater Fleet base being recalibrated.''"<br />"''Not anymore they're not. ''[&hellip;]'' Nuso Esva is currently loading them aboard his own ships somewhere on Poln Minor.|[[Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kauf Ularno|Ularno]]|<ref name="Choices" />}}
The [[Dreadnaught/Legends|Dreadnought]] ''Sarissa'' was armed with fifty [[Caldorf VII interceptor missile]]s and [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]. It was antiquated.<ref name="Choices" />

==Role==
The ''Sarissa'' served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], guarding the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector's]] [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]] while [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] Poln's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Poln Major]]. It was part of Candoras' [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bidor Ferrouz]]'s [[Ferrouz's sector fleet|sector fleet]].<ref name="Choices" />

==History==
{{Quote|And the ''Sarissa''{{'s}} also now moving up to support the ''Admonitor''.''"<br />"''Right. ''[&hellip;]'' Looks like whoever's in charge is pulling in every turbolaser he's got.|Commandant Barcelle and Han Solo, posing as a Major Axlon|<ref name="Choices" />}}
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> the ''Sarissa''{{'s}} [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] were supposedly sent to the Imperial [[Spillwater Fleet base]] to be calibrated, as it was suspected that their guidance systems were malfunctioning; however, that was untrue, as Imperial [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] had sent them to Poln's planet [[Poln Minor]], where the forces of<ref name="Choices" /> [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] [[Thief/Legends|stole]] them. [[Gender/Legends|His]] [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] then loaded them aboard their fifty [[Whisperlike fighter]]s.<ref name="Choices" />

[[File:Executor-SWE.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The ''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought ''Executor'' (pictured) fought the Eastern Fleet alongside the ''Sarissa''.]]
After the Imperial [[Task Force Admonitor|Task Force ''Admonitor'']] and the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] arrived over Poln Major, Esva's massive [[Eastern Fleet]] arrived, with its twenty-eight [[Firekiln]] warships prepared to destroy the ''Sarissa'' and Candoras' [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] if they attempted to assist the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. Esva also put the ''Chimaera'' on a collision course with Poln's [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan I]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] and trapped Task Force ''Admonitor'' and the ''Sarissa'' with Poln Minor's [[Gravity/Legends|gravvity]] well; however, the ''Chimaera'' was able to move away from its collision course and the ''Sarissa'' moved to assist the ''Admonitor'', as reported by the Golan's [[Commandant/Legends|Commandant]] [[Barcelle]]. The Whisperlikes with the dreadnought's missiles attempted to destroy the ''Admonitor'', but the Golan destroyed them before they could near their target. Shortly after, the Imperial [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], whose [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] was the massive [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], arrived and helped destroy Esva's entire Eastern Fleet.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Sarissa'' appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Choices" />
